Host-service OS lease precedes actual BootstrapForInvocation. Reused Session never adopts or stops another owner. Failed bootstrap offers one authenticated failure in a maximum-five-second window, then stops only its own Session and releases its lease. Publish/flush does not prove caller receipt.

Delayed/repeated original invocation refreshes actual scoped kernel and existing FILE record plus selected owned Docker inspection. Cached receipt and expired write proof are not retimestamped. Only an actual owning started Session may retain started for its original invocation.
